A concise explanation of what this website collects and why.
General enquiries can include your name, mobile number, email, city, user type, product interest and application details. Technical data sheet requests collect your name, mobile number, requested product, submission source and time.
The information is used to respond to enquiries, understand product interest, provide requested technical documents and improve relevant follow-up. It is not collected through the website for direct online payment.
Submission records are available only through the protected Resibond administration portal and authorised database access. Records should be retained only for legitimate enquiry follow-up and operational reporting.
You can ask the Resibond team to review or remove information submitted through this website by using the contact form and identifying the relevant mobile number, or by emailing customercare@astraladhesives.com .

values: Which Resibond product is suitable for bathroom gaps?

Bathmate is mapped to washbasin, sink and interior gap-filling applications. Sanitary Super White and Neutral 3010 cover other sanitary or glazing-related routes. Confirm the final choice from the current TDS.
How long should a bathroom sealant cure before water exposure?
Cure time depends on product, bead size and site conditions. Bathmate guidance calls for at least 24 hours before water exposure; always follow the current product TDS.
Can every bathroom sealant be used on stone?
No. Natural stone and sensitive finishes may require a compatible neutral-cure product and prior testing. Review the product TDS before application.
What sealant should be used around UPVC windows?
Doors & Windows is mapped to UPVC frame and masonry gaps, while Neutral 3010 covers additional UPVC and glazing routes. Exposure and joint movement determine final suitability.
Can window perimeter sealant be painted?
Doors & Windows is a paintable acrylic route. Silicone products generally require different finishing expectations, so check the relevant TDS.
Which product is used between a window frame and wall?
GP 100, Premium GP 1010 and Doors & Windows are associated with different frame and wall-junction applications. Select according to frame material, exposure and finish.
Which Resibond silicone is used for exterior glazing?
Weather 5010 is mapped to exterior glazing and façade weather sealing. Neutral 3010 and other glazing products address different substrates and conditions.
Can acetoxy silicone be used on every glazing frame?
No. Acetoxy chemistry may not suit sensitive metals, coatings or substrates. Confirm compatibility using the current TDS and an adhesion test.
Which Resibond sealant is intended for weatherproofing?
Weather 5010 is the primary mapped route for exterior weather sealing, façades, curtain walls and exposed glazing.
Can general-purpose silicone be used for façade joints?
Do not assume general-purpose products meet façade movement or durability requirements. Use a product and joint design verified for the actual exposure.
Does every exterior joint require primer?
Primer requirements vary by product and substrate. Conduct an adhesion assessment and follow the latest TDS and project specification.
Which Resibond adhesive can mount panels without nails?
Zero Nail and Saves Nails are mapped to fixing applications, while Hybrid 2 in 1 covers broader sealing and bonding work. Load and substrate determine final selection.
Can mounting adhesive be used for mirrors?
Only use a product confirmed compatible with the mirror backing. Zero Nail and Mirror Mount are associated with mirror routes, subject to current technical guidance.
Do heavy items need temporary support?
Yes. Heavy or safety-critical items may need temporary support during cure and permanent mechanical restraint depending on the load and application.
